items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Maybe you remember. It wasn’t Dick Cavett? I’m not sure whose show it was.

ctx.x: whether you’d call -- consider the Collective Black Artists in that vein, or Jazz and the People’s Movement, but some things along those lines.

We’ll start with the Jazz and People’s Movement. That was a brainchild of the late Rahsaan Roland Kirk. They successfully disrupted a television show. I’m trying to think whose show it was. Maybe you remember. It wasn’t Dick Cavett? I’m not sure whose show it was.
It’s somewhere in my notes, which I don’t feel like rifling through.
